Thanks Priyom.

Bexley typically requests the vendor (Redwood) to sign first so we can countersign after our VP Legal completes ID verification. For high-risk partners we require either (a) a physical witness signature on countersign, or (b) DocuSign ID Verification (Knowledge-based or government ID scan). For this agreement, IDV is acceptable.

We'll prepare a DocuSign envelope and route it: Priyom (exec) -> Redwood legal (Laura) -> Sarah (Bexley coordinator, for notification) -> VP Legal (countersign). Envelope status link will be shared once created.
